vanta.mods.note.unsupported_type: %1$s is a %2$s, which VANTA does not install
vanta.mods.note.incompatible: %1$s was not installed: it is incompatible with %2$s
vanta.mods.note.missing_dependency: %1$s was not installed: it needs %2$s, which has no compatible version

vanta.mods.error.http: Modrinth answered with an error. Try again later.
vanta.mods.error.rate_limited: Modrinth is busy right now. Wait a minute and try again.
vanta.mods.error.hash_mismatch: A download did not match its SHA-512 checksum and was deleted.
vanta.mods.error.unsafe_file: The file Modrinth offers cannot be installed safely.
vanta.mods.error.file_exists: A file with the same name is already there and was left untouched.
vanta.mods.error.local_io: A file could not be written. Check the game folder.
vanta.about.fair_play.title: Fair play
vanta.profiles.unsaved.title: Unsaved changes
vanta.profiles.unsaved.body: Your current %s differ from the active profile “%s”. Save them or activate a profile to switch.
vanta.profiles.name_ok: Letters, numbers and spaces – up to 64 characters
vanta.profiles.name_too_long: Names can have at most 64 characters
vanta.profiles.name_taken: A profile with this name already exists
vanta.profiles.confirm_reset.title: Reset “%s”?
vanta.profiles.confirm_reset.body: The profile returns to the settings, HUD layout, crosshair and cosmetics it shipped with. Its name and icon are kept.
vanta.profiles.confirm_delete_active.bod: This cannot be undone. “%s” becomes the active profile.
vanta.profiles.copied_json: JSON copied to the clipboard as well
vanta.profiles.create.title: Save current as profile
vanta.profiles.create.hint: Stores your current settings, HUD layout, crosshair, cosmetics and VANTA keys as a new profile.
vanta.profiles.duplicate.title: Duplicate “%s”
vanta.profiles.duplicate.hint: The copy gets the same content and can be edited independently.
vanta.profiles.import.title: Import profile
vanta.profiles.import.clipboard_hint: Copy the JSON of an exported profile, then press Import. The file is checked before anything is added.
vanta.profiles.import.folder_hint: Drop .json profile files into %s, then press Refresh and pick a file.
vanta.profiles.import.no_files: No .json files in the imports folder yet
vanta.profiles.notification.reset.title: Profile reset
vanta.profiles.notification.saved.title: Profile updated
vanta.keybinds.conflicts.body: %s actions share a key and trigger together. Rebind one of each pair.
vanta.keybinds.no_conflicts.body: Every key is bound to a single action.
vanta.keybinds.all_default: All keys are at their defaults
vanta.keybinds.open_vanilla.tooltip: Opens Minecraft's own controls screen – mouse buttons are bound there
vanta.keybinds.no_matches.hint: Try another action name, category or key name.
vanta.cosmetics.footer: Cosmetics are visual only – they never affect gameplay.
vanta.cosmetics.crosshair_more.body: The crosshair editor lets you change shape, size, gap, colour and outline freely.
vanta.cosmetics.crosshair_editor_unavail: The crosshair editor is not available in this build
vanta.cosmetics.backgrounds_note: The background is drawn behind the VANTA main menu. The vanilla panorama keeps Minecraft's rotating scenery under a dark vignette.
vanta.cosmetics.hud_note: The HUD style applies to every widget. Individual colours and opacity are set per widget in the HUD editor.
vanta.cosmetics.particles_note: Particles are drawn over the main menu background only and pause when reduced motion is on.
vanta.cosmetics.badges_note: Badges are purely visual labels shown next to your name in VANTA menus. They have no gameplay effect and other players never see them.
vanta.cosmetics.packs_hint: Packs are JSON files with extra UI themes – no code. Drop them into %s and press Refresh.
vanta.cosmetics.pack_tooltip: Pack themes appear in the Themes section
vanta.cosmetics.background.graphite_grid: Perspective floor grid with a lit horizon
vanta.cosmetics.background.violet_horizo: Violet-to-blue glow on a dark sky
vanta.cosmetics.background.vanilla_panor: Minecraft's panorama under a dark vignette
vanta.cosmetics.hudtheme.glass.descripti: Translucent panels with a soft border
vanta.cosmetics.hudtheme.outline.descrip: Transparent panels with an accent outline
vanta.cosmetics.badge.none.description: No badge next to your name
vanta.stats.current.none: This session is not being recorded
vanta.stats.no_sessions.hint: A session is saved when you quit the game. Play a while and come back.
vanta.stats.disabled.body: Nothing is recorded while statistics are off. Existing data is kept until you clear it.
vanta.stats.copied: JSON copied to the clipboard as well
